headline: Two sidebar dashboards redesigned — cleaner navigation tree + sharper Quick Commands typography.

items.prompt_template: I redesigned two of your sidebar dashboards. The Workspace Map is now a pure navigation tree — org → projects, with optional stuck-people inline. The engagement chart, count pills, key-people block, and Run Weekly Audit button are gone (use the `weekly audit` chat trigger instead). All sections are collapsible. The Quick Commands cheat sheet got a typography pass for legibility — same command set, easier to read. Both auto-rebuilt during this update.
